title: The effects of male and female training manikins on resuscitation performance in a BLS simulation
summary: The study examines the impact of male and female training manikins in BLS training on performance in a simulated resuscitation scenario involving female and male manikins.

interventions.name: BLS performance on a male manikin following prior training on a male manikin. Analysis of anonymous data from a quality assurance exercise.
BLS performance on a male training manikin following prior training on a female training manikin. Analysis of anonymous data from a quality assurance exercise.
BLS performance on a female training manikin following prior training on a male training manikin. Analysis of anonymous data from a quality assurance exercise.
BLS performance on a female manikin following prior training on a female manikin. Analysis of anonymous data from a quality assurance exercise.
